data.title: 埃列什基伽勒 · 冥府床褥的奉献夜·「灵魂也要……一起重叠」
data.description: 【冥界寝宫·深夜】亡者的国度第一次有了体温。埃列什基伽勒仰卧在铺满蓝色薄纱的大床上，双腿轻微分开，金发散落如流淌的月光——「人类与女神……生前与死后……哈啊……全部、全部都重叠在一起……灵魂也要、一起重叠……这种温暖……啊……比整个冥界都要重……」
data.action: 仰卧冥界床褥双腿轻微分开自抚，超长金发如月光散落，红瞳失神泛起动情泪光
data.lighting: 魂火幽光与床褥纱幔的柔光
data.camera: vertical POV, supine, touching own body, underworld bed, glowing blue gauze and soulfire
data.promptProse: The quiet land of the dead knows profound warmth for the very first time. Lying back upon a grand bed draped in gossamer pale-blue gauze, Ereshkigal lets her magnificent golden hair spill out like liquid moonlight across the pillows. Her delicate chest rises and falls with trembling, sacred breaths, pink nipples taut beneath the ghostly soul-glow as her slender fingers drift between her parted pale thighs. Tears of long-buried longing glisten in her crimson eyes, whispering through parted lips that this warmth is far heavier and more precious than the entire underworld. Sensual vertical composition, cinematic lighting, ethereal blue glow, detailed underworld background.
